target_market: India - 360° Photographers, Google Street View Trusted Creators & Virtual Tour Agencies

positioning_angles.angle: Google Street View & Google Maps Publishing
positioning_angles.hook: Publish high-resolution connected 360° virtual tours directly to Google Street View and Google Maps for local Indian businesses (showrooms, restaurants, hotels, schools, hospitals, gyms).
positioning_angles.pain_point_solved: Creators often struggle with complex or broken Street View tools and unlinked panoramas.

positioning_angles.angle: Affordable Pay As You Go (₹100 per tour credit)
positioning_angles.hook: No expensive USD subscriptions. Pay ₹100 per tour credit that never expires. Ideal for freelance photographers and project-based studios in India.
positioning_angles.pain_point_solved: Matterport and US-based platforms charge heavy monthly recurring dollar subscriptions ($30-$70+/mo) which are costly for independent Indian photographers with seasonal or irregular projects.

positioning_angles.hook: Fast, branded virtual tour player with custom nadir tripod logo patching and ready-to-paste embed codes for client websites.
positioning_angles.pain_point_solved: Delivering clean tours without third-party watermarks.

outreach_tone: Respectful, peer-to-peer, creator-to-creator, focused on client business and Google Maps workflow. Never spammy.
